sentences.text:
The first bail application was disposed of by following order dated 10.05.2024 :-
"This application was filed on 23.03.2023 and it was taken up for hearing earlier on four dates, however, it was mainly adjourned on request of counsel for applicant.

The applicant before this Court is facing trial for offence of rape of a minor girl in Case Crime No. 158 of 2022, under Sections 363, 376, 328 I.P.C. and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station - Asothar, District - Fatehpur.

sentences.text: Ms. Abida Syed, learned counsel for C.W.C. submits that victim in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that applicant has committed rape, however, she has no instruction whether statement of victim still be recorded during trial or not.

In the aforesaid circumstances, considering nature of evidence collected during investigation as well as the contents of statement of victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., however, it is not on record whether statement of victim has been recorded till date or not, therefore, present bail application is disposed of with direction that learned Trial Court will record statement of victim, if already not recorded within period of three months from today and thereafter applicant will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court as advised, along with status of trial. "

Applicant has again approached this Court by way of filing present bail application in Case Crime No. 158 of 2022, under Sections 363, 376, 328 I.P.C. and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station - Asothar, District - Fatehpur.

In pursuance of an order passed by this Court, learned Trial Court has submitted a report dated 15.11.2024 that out of 11 proposed witnesses, 5 have been examined including the victim and trial may be concluded within three months.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 29.09.2022 i.e. more than two years.

Learned counsel refers the statement of victim that he was acquainted with applicant and due to some dispute with her family, she left her house and later on she met with present applicant who asked her to stay along with family, however, when she recovered, she made story of rape.

Learned counsel for applicant has not able to deny that victim remains consistent in her examination-in-chief and later on in her cross-examination also that applicant has committed offence of rape with her.
Learned A.G.A. for State has opposed the above submission and refers statement of minor victim.

I have considered the above submission and considering the nature of evidence of victim which appears to be consistent even in her cross-examination, therefore, taking note of nature of allegation and minimum sentence prescribed, the Court is of considered opinion that detention period could not be considered as a prolong detention.

Accordingly, prayer for bail is rejected and application is disposed of with an observation that trial will be concluded expeditiously and in case, it is not much proceeded within period of eight months, applicant will have liberty to approach this Court, if so advised.
